items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: we had Notre Dutre on trombone

ctx.x: David Jones playing alto, mellophone and sax. We had Johnny Dots playing clarinet. We had Lilian Armstrong on piano. We had Minor Hall on drums, and we had Notre Dutre on trombone, and myself on bass, and King Oliver was playing. That's the way the band was picked up when we went to Frisco, playing at the Procola dance hall.
And when you came west, did you plan to stay here, or did you just come for a short trip? Well, we come to play that engagement, that's all.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Nora Dutre on trombone. Uh, we had, uh, Jimmy Polar on violin. Uh, we had a band. And I was on the bass.

ctx.x: They fired Jimmy Polar. Oh yeah. I remember that. You see, I'll give you the lineup of the band we left fairly well with. We had, uh, we think from the piano. We had Lil Hardin on piano. We had Johnny Dotson on Clionet. Joe Oliver on trumpet. Nora Dutre on trombone. Uh, we had, uh, Jimmy Polar on violin. Uh, we had a band. And I was on the bass. Ram was on the drums. Okay. Then, they want to turn this boy loose, give him a note. Didn't give him no notice. Just fired him.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Nora on trombone, Lil on piano, myself on bass, Joe

ctx.x: And he could execute on a mellophone as fast as John Dots could on his clarinet. And he played an alto sax too. Well, we was playing there and Jimmy Pilar was playing violin and doubling on his beat tenor, you know, tenor saxophone, Nora on trombone, Lil on piano, myself on bass, Joe, and around minor hall. So something come up and he wanted to do away with Jimmy. See, Jimmy Pilar. Yeah. And finally he was going to let Jimmy Pilar go and so minor taking it up. items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: I was on the boss. Honore Dutroy played trombone.

ctx.x: Who was in that band, Tootie, Tudi the Oliver band then, in 1921, who was playing with the King then?
Let's see. The Great King Oliver.
